I'm sorry, that's frustrating, especially with a live plant sitting outside somewhere. When tracking shows delivered but nothing arrived, please contact support so we can open a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the package is found to be lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund.

To get this started, please send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456). In the meantime, it's worth checking around your property, with neighbors, and with anyone else in your household who might have taken it in.
